श्लिकु,
 I. m. A servant.
 II. n.(?), Astronomy.
1. श्लिष् श्लिष्, i. 4, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.,

); the original signification seems to have been, To adhere (cf. श्रि).
 1. To embrace,

. To tie, Hit. i. d. 83.
 3. To join, Daśak. in
. श्लिष्ट, Touched by, clung or adhered to, leaning on,

, Seramp.
 --Comp.
 --† i. 10, Par. To unite.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
 1. To embrace,
. With उरसा, To press against one's breast, Daśak. in

.
 --With वि वि, To burst, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 67. विश्लिष्ट, Separated, disunited.
 --

. To disunite, Pañc. 42, 7.
 --With सम् सम्, with उरसा, To press against one's breast,

. संश्लिष्ट,
 1. Close together, adjoining, touching.
 2. United, joined, Pañc. ii. d. 136.
 3. Endowed, Pañc. 143, 8.
 4. Embraced.
 --Caus. To join,
श्लीपद, i. e. probably श्लिष्-पद, n. Morbid enlargement of the legs (cf. शिलीपद and the next).
श्लीपदिन्, i. e. श्लीपद + इन्, adj. Club-footed,

श्लील, i. e. श्री + ल (cf. श्रील), adj. Prosperous.
 --Comp.
